caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with an ornate design. The chair is predominantly black with gold accents. The backrest is rectangular with a decorative panel containing intricate gold floral patterns, scrolls, and a central medallion featuring the portrait of a person with short hair and a red and white garment. Below the main backrest is another smaller horizontal panel with a matching gold ornamental motif. The chair seat appears to be woven or caned, depicted with a cross-hatch texture in a light beige or tan color. The chair legs are turned and tapered, with additional gold details, and are connected by stretchers for support. The front stretcher is decorated with a central gold accent. The arms and legs of the chair, as well as the upper part of the backrest, feature additional gold embellishments and curved lines, contributing to the overall elaborate style of the chair. The background of the drawing is plain off-white.
title: Chair
